easyPrerequisites: There are four or more permanent cards in your graveyard.
description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Coati Scavenger, adding {B}.
When Coati Scavenger dies, Kaya's Ghostform triggers, returning Coati Scavenger from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Coati Scavenger enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Kaya's Ghostform from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Kaya's Ghostform by paying {B}, attaching it to Coati Scavenger.
Repeat.
